craft_notes: Sthāyin: single-stone making. Sanskrit-first: ekatattvānta kept whole. Rows: 2. Close: cleansing present. Rejected: explaining ekatattva — killed: song shows, note tells. Read aloud: forging cadence — steep, speak.

lines: One stone for all stones, Śiva-steeped and true —
